key_functions: Provide free and competent legal services to the eligible weaker sections of society
Organize Lok Adalats for amicable settlement of pending disputes and pre-litigation claims
Promote legal literacy and legal awareness campaigns across India

statutory_income_ceilings_by_state.Delhi: Rs 3,00,000 per annum (Rs 5,00,000 for High Court / Supreme Court)

automatic_eligibility_without_income_pro: Members of Scheduled Castes (SC) or Scheduled Tribes (ST)
Victims of human trafficking or forced labour (begar)

tier_1_district.name: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (DCDRC)
tier_1_district.pecuniary_limit: Value of goods/services paid up to Rs 50 Lakhs
tier_1_district.filing_mode: Physical at District Court or Online via e-Daakhil (edaakhil.nic.in)

tier_2_state.name: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (SCDRC)
tier_2_state.pecuniary_limit: Value of goods/services paid between Rs 50 Lakhs and Rs 2 Crores
tier_2_state.appeal_from: Orders of District Commission within 45 days

tier_3_national.name: National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission (NCDRC)
tier_3_national.pecuniary_limit: Value of goods/services paid exceeds Rs 2 Crores
tier_3_national.appeal_from: Orders of State Commission within 30 days
